patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient presents with a year-long history of severe vulvar itching and pain during sexual intercourse that has gradually worsened. She has tried over-the-counter lubricants without significant relief. Menopause occurred 8 years ago. Her medical history is significant for diet-controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus and hypertension treated with hydrochlorothiazide.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (diet-controlled), hypertension (treated with hydrochlorothiazide), menopause at 52 years of age.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Married, sexually active with her husband until recently due to severe pain. Non-smoker, drinks alcohol socially.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies urinary incontinence, postcoital bleeding, or recent changes in skin elsewhere on the body.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and manage a patient presenting with vulvar itching and discomfort.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: For about a year now I’ve had severe vulvar itching that’s getting worse, and sex has started to hurt a lot. Even with over-the-counter lubricants, I haven’t gotten much relief.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your current health, have you noticed any changes in your eyesight, such as blurriness, dark spots, or any loss of vision?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my eyesight—no blurriness, dark spots, or loss of vision.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t smoke and I’ve never been a smoker.

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nausea or felt sick to my stomach.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breast area, and nothing there is causing pain.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that physical symptoms can often be linked to how we are feeling emotionally. Lately, have you been experiencing a significant amount of stress or feeling under a lot of pressure?
turns.patient_answer: “I wouldn’t say I’ve had significant new stress or pressure lately. Most of the problem feels directly related to the worsening vulvar itching and the pain with intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me better understand your current symptoms, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine, such as it appearing darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any changes in the color of my urine—it looks normal to me.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand that finding a change in your breast can be concerning. To help me better understand what you are experiencing, could you tell me if you have noticed this mass growing or changing in size rapidly over a short period of time?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any breast lumps or anything changing in size quickly.”

turns.doctor_question: I'm sorry to hear you're not feeling well. To help me better understand what might be going on, could you tell me if you have been experiencing any pain in your wrist?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any pain in my wrist.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a clearer picture of what’s going on, could you please check your arms for me? Have you noticed any skin lesions, such as rashes, bumps, or marks, running along the path of the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or marks along the veins on my arms.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, I’d like to ask about your breathing: Do you find that you experience shortness of breath or difficulty catching your breath when you are physically active, such as walking or climbing stairs?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t had shortness of breath or trouble catching my breath with walking or climbing stairs.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a clearer picture of your health, could you tell me if you have used any recreational or non-prescribed drugs recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t used any recreational or non-prescribed drugs recently.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of what you're experiencing, have you noticed any areas of skin that feel rough or have a scaly texture?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed rough or scaly patches on other parts of my skin—though the vulvar area itself feels very itchy and sore and hurts during sex.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of what you're experiencing, could you tell me if you have noticed any firm or immovable lumps or masses in your thigh area?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any firm or immovable lumps or masses in my thigh area, and nothing there seems out of the ordinary.”
